stem: Ravi's teacher asks the class to classify some resources used at home in their village. A resource is renewable if it is replenished naturally within a reasonable period of time, and non-renewable if it takes millions of years to form and gets exhausted after use. Which of the following resources should Ravi classify as non-renewable?

options.text: Firewood collected from trees that are replanted every year
Kerosene oil, a fuel obtained from petroleum
Wind energy used to pump water from the well
Sunlight used to dry grain in the courtyard

teacher.key_rationale: Kerosene is obtained from petroleum, a fossil fuel that takes millions of years to form, is limited, and is not replenished within a reasonable time, so it is non-renewable. Firewood (with replanting), wind, and sunlight are replenished naturally within a reasonable time and are renewable.
